marginal_dps_distribution_bought_vs_skip: NOT RECORDED — purchase_offer/purchase_decision record item effect keys and flat stat values, weapon damage/scaling, and the shop composite score, but NOT the combat_value()/marginal-DPS gain of each offer. The lowered OFFENSE_IMPACT_MIN_ITEM_GAIN (a DPS threshold) therefore cannot be set from existing telemetry; it needs an offline combat_value() replay over the recorded offers, or a new capture field.
offense_conversion_proxy: Since marginal DPS is unrecorded, offense-item buy rate (offense-stat items bought / offered at w9-15) is the best available conversion proxy: victory 42% (98/234) vs defeat 31% (58/190).
